firm_data.firm_description: Garwin Gerstein & Fisher LLP (GGF) is a law firm specializing in representing plaintiffs in various types of complex litigation. The Firm’s primary focus is on representing antitrust plaintiffs whose businesses have been adversely affected by price-fixing cartels and monopolies.
notable_facts: Recovered over $2.5 billion on behalf of its clients
Recognized for its ground-breaking work challenging illegal agreements between brand and generic pharmaceutical companies

email.subject: AI for Garwin Gerstein & Fisher LLP - built for antitrust plaintiffs counsel
email.body:
Hi Bruce,

Over 80 years, GGF has recovered over $2.5 billion for clients harmed by price-fixing and monopolies. That track record demands systems that scale without losing the precision your antitrust work requires.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of plaintiff-side practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving regionally to meet firms like yours. I'd be happy to stop by to share how we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
